plan.title: Pathway & TF activity footprint: cytokine vs vehicle BEC
plan.analytical_narrative: The research question explicitly asks for signaling pathway activity judged by transcriptional footprint, not member expression — this is a footprint-method question (PROGENy/decoupleR), not a plain enrichment question. The design is a clean 6-vs-6 unpaired single-batch bulk RNA-seq comparison of cytokine-stimulated vs vehicle-treated bronchial epithelium, with one flagged low-depth sample (sample_01, ~4x below median library size) that must be inspected, not silently dropped. The plan: (1) import Salmon gene-level counts, run sample-structure QC (blind VST, PCA, sample-distance heatmap, library-size/detected-gene table) to place sample_01 in context and decide with a stated reason whether it stays; (2) fit the standard DESeq2 Wald model (~condition, treated vs control, explicit reference level) with minimal pre-filtering and apeglm shrinkage, since DESeq2's size factors down-weight low depth without needing removal; (3) derive the Wald statistic ranking for every tested gene and feed it into decoupleR mlm on the PROGENy human footprint model for pathway activity (the direct answer to 'active pathways by footprint') and decoupleR ulm on CollecTRI human regulons for the complementary transcription-factor-activity view; (4) run fgsea preranked GSEA on Hallmark, then Reactome and WikiPathways-human, as a broader functional-enrichment cross-check, reporting overlap and redundancy; (5) integrate everything into one report that states thresholds, package versions, the sample_01 decision and its effect, and explicitly separates the footprint-based pathway call from a naive member-expression view.

steps.method: DESeq2 vst(blind), PCA, sample distance heatmap, library size review
Keep genes with >=10 counts in >=6 samples (smallest group size)
DESeq2 design ~condition, explicit reference level = control
decoupleR mlm on PROGENy human footprint model (top 500 responsive genes per pathway), on the DESeq2 Wald statistic
decoupleR ulm on CollecTRI human regulons, on the DESeq2 Wald statistic
fgsea preranked GSEA on the Wald statistic, MSigDB Hallmark then Reactome/WikiPathways
Integrated report: QC, DE, pathway/TF activity, enrichment, reproducibility record
